notes:
- Install Drop Four separately from the official game catalog. The built-in LÖVE player supports solo play, pass and play, online turns, and compatible manual .love imports.
- Invite friends by QR code or link, exchange encrypted messages, and place one-to-one voice calls. Control mute and speaker from the call bar.
- Open the exact conversation or Drop Four match from an alert. Your turn in My Games also opens the board when the required game version is installed.
- Set game volume, music, and sound effects. Game volume lowers during voice calls by default and returns to your setting afterward.
- After Android closes the process, Zompado checks for alerts on Android’s schedule. Calls can be answered from an alert if they are still ringing when the check runs.
